name: WolfRunResult
meaning: result bits of Wolf::RunMove / events of Wolf::RunStep

name: WOLF_RUN_CRASH
meaning: RunMove doc: head-on wall hit at half speed or more -> result bit 1; RunStep: crash -> stop

name: WOLF_RUN_BRAKE
meaning: RunStep: events & 2 outside state 0x24 -> 0x24 keeping the sound (inferred)

name: WOLF_RUN_SLIDE
meaning: RunMove: |= 4 when Wolf_SurfaceVelocity applied (sliding); RunStep 4 -> state 9
